item.title: Shamzu Zayba Breaks Silence After Bail In Financial Fraud Case, Hits Back At Abhilasham Producers - Issue Explained
item.description: Director Shamzu Zayba has broken his silence after being released on bail in a financial fraud case linked to the film Abhilasham. Denying all allegations, he accused the producers of defaming him and questioned the manner of his arrest, even as the Producers’ Association backed the complainants raised by the producers of the film.
